text: At City Council's request, this report provides an update on the implementation by Toronto Community Housing Corporation (TCHC) of recommendations in Ombudsman Toronto's January, 2018 report of an Investigation into TCHC's Medical and Safety at Risk Priority Transfer Process for Tenants.
City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (March 21, 2019) from the Ombudsman for information.
